fusions.name: Split Ruling
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Two Roads Decreed
fusions.desc: Looses 2 bolts at once, spread apart, each of which deals 26 damage and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Either Course Allowed
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Bident of Office
fusions.desc: Conjures a two-pronged weapon of office: your weapon damage rises by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 2 ticks.
